who.name: Samantha Lawton
who.title: Franchisee (Marylebone group page)
who.organization: Women in Business Network - Marylebone Group

topOpportunities.recommendedAction: Ask Samantha whether the group ever considers alternative meeting venues or a separate business-networking session. Qualify venue flexibility, attendance and per-person budget before presenting a no-guestroom meeting-and-refreshments proposal.

topOpportunities.whyHotel: Secondary, qualification-stage opportunity—not a main-ball venue lead. The ball already names the InterContinental. Nobu Hotel London Portman Square is at 22 Portman Square, London W1H 7BG, in Marylebone; its official materials confirm 243 bedrooms and suites, private dining and event facilities. Its luxury lifestyle positioning makes an optional donor/sponsor dinner, a separate host gathering, or guest-paid accommodation a plausible product fit, but no event-specific demand or referral relationship is evidenced. Prioritise a small, organiser-approved ancillary booking rather than pitching ballroom displacement or assuming overflow. Do not promise walking time, transfers or late-night availability.
topOpportunities.whyNow: No time-critical sourcing trigger is established. Monitor until a programme owner confirms dates and venue openness.
topOpportunities.recommendedAction: Send one concise permission-based enquiry to Kate Rosenthal, using the published sponsorship contact, and ask for the current 2027 ball organiser. Suggested message: ‘We understand your 9 March ball is confirmed at the InterContinental. Would an optional guest-paid stay at Nobu Portman Square or a separate small sponsor/host dinner be useful, without changing your main venue arrangements? If so, who coordinates those requests, and are any existing hotel arrangements exclusive?’ Only after a positive response should Nobu prepare availability and terms. Its published event contact is events-portmansquare@nobuhotels.com, +44 (0)20 3988 5888. Treat sponsorship or a prize donation as a separate decision, not a condition of referrals.

topOpportunities.whyHotel: Conditional, lower-priority prospect for Nobu Hotel London Portman Square, not a verified accommodation account. Its official address is now resolved: 22 Portman Square, London W1H 7BG, United Kingdom. The hotel’s official brochure confirms 243 rooms and suites, meeting spaces and private dining. The credible luxury-lifestyle fit is occasional visiting senior project leaders, specialist designers or consultants, plus small executive reviews and hosted dinners, only if non-local travel and approved spend are confirmed. AECOM and Dr. Sauer & Partners are evidenced design participants. The construction site is Elephant & Castle, not Marylebone/Portman Square; there is no evidenced walking-distance demand anchor or existing hotel referral. Routine workforce rotations and cost-sensitive long stays are a weaker fit than senior visitor stays or off-site meetings. No exhibition-related overnight demand in Marylebone is established.
topOpportunities.whyNow: No time-critical sourcing trigger is established. Monitor until a programme owner confirms dates and venue openness.
topOpportunities.recommendedAction: Keep as a qualified-project/unqualified-lodging lead, not committed room revenue. First request a referral through Dragados’s published business contact to the ECSCU project administrator, travel/mobility lead or accommodation buyer. Use Bethan Haig or Steve Dawson as project-linked referrals for specialist visitor and meeting needs. Ask who pays and books, whether visitors actually need overnight stays, and whether a Marylebone luxury hotel is permitted and useful. Only then offer a narrowly scoped senior-visitor rate and small-meeting/private-dining proposal; do not propose a workforce room block without evidence.

topOpportunities.organization: Guy's and St Thomas' Education and Events
topOpportunities.whyHotel: Qualified prospect, not confirmed hotel business. Nobu Hotel London Portman Square’s official address is 22 Portman Square, London W1H 7BG, United Kingdom; its official pages place it in Marylebone and confirm 243 bedrooms and suites, the Nobu Ballroom, an 18-seat Sakura Boardroom, Sayuri Room and private-dining/catering capability. This supports a selective faculty/organiser accommodation, small faculty meeting or separately commissioned dinner proposition in the stated demand territory. Luxury positioning requires an explicit rate-policy and hospitality-policy fit. No verified walking time, event hotel partnership or overflow requirement was found.
topOpportunities.whyNow: No time-critical sourcing trigger is established. Monitor until a programme owner confirms dates and venue openness.

who.name: Tamanna Jahan
who.title: Event confirmation / routing contact
who.organization: Guy's and St Thomas' Education and Events

topOpportunities.recommendedAction: Send one concise enquiry to Tamanna Jahan at her published work address, using gstt.events@nhs.net as the official conference routing mailbox. Suggested approach: ‘We understand Clinical Update Sleep is confirmed at RCP on 30 April 2027. Does your team need any additional faculty/organiser accommodation, an approved delegate hotel referral option, or a separately arranged faculty dinner or small meeting in Marylebone? Do not pitch relocation of the conference, assert preferred-hotel status or assume an organiser-funded room block.

topOpportunities.organization: London School of Hygiene & Tropical Medicine
topOpportunities.whyHotel: Conditional prospect, not qualified group business. Nobu Hotel London Portman Square is at 22 Portman Square, London W1H 7BG, in Marylebone; LSHTM’s main campus is at Keppel Street, London WC1E 7HT, in Bloomsbury. Do not describe this as an established walking-distance campus partnership. The hotel’s 18-seat Sakura Boardroom, flexible Sayuri Room and private dining offer a plausible fit for a small faculty meeting, hosted reception or separately requested dinner; the ballroom should not be proposed without a demonstrated larger requirement. The modelling course’s provisional 2027 timetable actually schedules a London reception and course lunches, giving a specific hospitality discussion point, but neither venue availability nor an external catering requirement is established. Optional participant or visiting-faculty accommodation is possible, but LSHTM’s budget-oriented accommodation guidance makes a luxury hotel a selective, not default, fit.
topOpportunities.whyNow: No time-critical sourcing trigger is established. Monitor until a programme owner confirms dates and venue openness.

who.name: Carl May
who.title: Programme director, Implementation Science and Implementation Dynamics
who.organization: London School of Hygiene & Tropical Medicine

topOpportunities.recommendedAction: Send a short qualification enquiry to the published Short Courses team, shortcourses@lshtm.ac.uk, asking them to route it to the relevant programme director and operational organiser. Prioritise February 2027 Implementation Science for a wholly in-person cohort and June 2027 modelling for its explicitly scheduled reception/course lunches. Offer an optional, separately priced accommodation/referral arrangement and small hosted-event options, not a presumed residential package or relocation of teaching. Ask whether hospitality is already assigned before quoting. If there is interest, involve the actual budget holder and Procurement/TMC as appropriate; obtain availability and an accessible-space proposal from events-portmansquare@nobuhotels.com. Do not describe academic directors as buyers or signatories without confirmation.

topOpportunities.whyHotel: Qualified prospect for luxury client-hosting and event-linked accommodation, not a confirmed MCC room-block opportunity. Nobu Hotel London Portman Square’s official address is 22 Portman Square, London W1H 7BG, United Kingdom; its official website is https://www.nobuhotels.com/london-portman/. Its Marylebone luxury-lifestyle positioning, 243 bedrooms and suites, ballroom, 18-seat Sakura Boardroom and private dining support sponsor/client briefings, dinners and visiting VIP stays. Lord’s already provides premium suites, shared dining and food and beverage, so the legitimate proposition is complementary off-site hosting or accommodation, not replacement matchday catering. The two multi-day Tests are the strongest windows to qualify extended stays, but duration alone proves no room nights. Importantly, Cricket Australia Travel Office explicitly sells a Lord’s 2027 Ashes package including accommodation: event-linked lodging is evidenced at programme level, although neither Nobu nor an MCC purchase is identified.
topOpportunities.whyNow: No time-critical sourcing trigger is established. Monitor until a programme owner confirms dates and venue openness.
topOpportunities.recommendedAction: Proceed to targeted qualification, not a speculative room-block forecast. Send a concise hotel capability and accommodation/referral proposal to hospitality@mcc.org.uk (020 7616 8598), asking for routing to Andy Muggleton’s commercial team and the appropriate Events & Experiences lead. Offer separately priced accommodation, boardroom/briefing space and private dining around the four fixture windows, subject to actual hotel availability. Ask whether there is an approved hotel/referral process and whether Destination Sport Travel handles any relevant London requirements; its public route is info@destinationsport.com. In parallel, contact Cricket Australia Travel Office at info@crickettraveloffice.com.au about the already-advertised Lord’s Ashes accommodation programme, requesting its accommodation-contracting contact and whether inventory is still being sourced. Treat this as a separate supporter-travel sales opportunity. Seek production introductions only after the responsible broadcaster or production company confirms an overnight requirement. Do not hold inventory or advertise ticket-inclusive packages without agreed terms and permissions.

topOpportunities.organization: Office for Equality and Opportunity / UK Government
topOpportunities.whyHotel: Credible early-stage London conference lead, not a qualified hotel booking. Nobu Hotel London Portman Square is verified at 22 Portman Square, London W1H 7BG, in Marylebone. Its official events page confirms 243 bedrooms and suites, three event spaces, a ballroom accommodating up to 700 for receptions, an 18-seat Sakura Boardroom, the flexible Sayuri Room, private dining and catering. This supports a conditional pitch for delegate accommodation, bilateral/organiser meetings or a separately commissioned reception. The 700 figure is reception capacity, not verified plenary seating. There is no evidence that the Forum is sourcing in Marylebone/Portman Square, that its venue will be walkable from the hotel, or that a luxury property meets public-sector rates and value-for-money requirements. Main-conference suitability depends on the actual plenary, breakout, access and security brief.
topOpportunities.whyNow: Public-sector programme history may support relationship development for future editions, but no verified open procurement window or forthcoming bookable edition has been confirmed from public research alone.

who.name: Evgenia Giakoumopoulou
who.title: Event confirmation / routing contact
who.organization: Office for Equality and Opportunity / UK Government

topOpportunities.recommendedAction: Qualify before quoting or holding inventory. Use the OEO organisation page’s official contact route, addressed to the Office for Equality and Opportunity Correspondence Team, to request referral to the civil-servant lead for the 2027 Forum and the authorised commercial/venue-sourcing team. The Council of Europe SOGI Unit contact form is a secondary programme-routing route. Ask whether venue and accommodation sourcing remain open, who signs contracts, whether an agency/framework is mandated, and how a hotel may legitimately submit information. After that referral, offer a concise, non-binding and itemised capability note covering the verified Portman Square address, meeting configurations, accessible provision, catering and accommodation options, expressly subject to dates, availability, permitted rates and procurement rules. The hotel publishes events-portmansquare@nobuhotels.com for internal event-package coordination; it is not the organiser’s contact. Do not solicit a ministerial booking decision or offer personal hospitality/upgrades to influence selection. If the main venue is already appointed, pursue only expressly authorised side-meeting, reception or delegate-hotel requirements with confirmed geography and booking ownership.
